definition: GPT-6 Astra is a large language model (LLM) developed by American artificial intelligence firm OpenAI.
details: It was initially released to approved users on September 3, 2026, with general availability coming the following day.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is GPT-6 Astra — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
